# What events blocks do
Events blocks are yellow. Every program starts with an Events block, because it tells the computer when to begin. Blocks that are not under an Events block never run.

# when green flag clicked
Starts your program when you press the Run button. This is the block you will use most.

# when kit connected
Runs once as soon as the kit connects. Use it to show a welcome message on the display.

# when button pressed
Runs when you press the button on the controller. Choose which button in the drop-down.

# broadcast message and when I receive
Broadcast sends a named message and when I receive runs a stack when that message arrives. Use them to make two stacks work together, for example the line follower and the wall stopper.
